title: Intel DNS Record — single RR observed for a target domain. Use intel-domain for hosts/IPs/ASNs; use this type for raw resolver output.

name.description: Fully qualified owner name of the record (e.g., 'api.example.com', 'example.com').

value.description: RDATA value (e.g., IP address for A, target FQDN for CNAME/MX, string for TXT).

first_seen.description: ISO8601 or free-form date of first observation (e.g., '2024-11-03', '~Nov 2024').

last_seen.description: ISO8601 or free-form date of most recent observation; omit if same as first_seen.

notes.description: Contextual flags: dangling CNAME, wildcard match, interesting SPF include, zone-transfer output, etc.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row (e.g., 'recon-specialist').

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim resolver output line that supports this record.
